newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent holds API inspired gains, awaits NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent holds API inspired gains, awaits NYMEX.

text.p: IPE Brent futures held on to early gains made on the back of bullish U.S. crude stocks data and some traders saw crude extending the rally into the afternoon session if NYMEX came in stronger.
"One might expect something of a rally later on," said one trader. "It depends very much on how the heating oil performs in the States this afternoon."
April Brent was trading 18 cents higher at $19.68 a barrel by 1302 GMT, having earlier hit a morning session high of $19.73 a barrel.
March gas oil was up $2.25 at $166 a tonne.
"It might be fairly steady depending on their (U.S.) weather, we might see a continuation of the short covering we've been seeing over the last few days," the trader said.
"If we start getting too wayward on the upside we are going to run into a lot of selling."
The market got an early morning boost from data released by the American Petroleum Institute.
These showed U.S. crude stocks fell by $7.6 million barrels in the week ending February 28.

The shortfall left stocks 5.2 million barrels above the same period last year, although traders took the number to be a positive sign considering most expected a week-on-week increase of around 3.0 million barrels.
"It's up on the back of APIs...Now we've got to wait to see what NYMEX brings in this afternoon," another trader said.
